root_cause_analysis: The editorial engine detected a data integrity mismatch between the source metrics and the deck metrics. The deck metrics contain percentage-formatted values (10%, 15%, 30%, 5%) that are not present in the source metrics list (10, 2026, 25, 30, 38, 40%), triggering a validation failure in the numeric fact-check module.
actionable_instructions: Verify the source data ingestion layer to ensure percentage symbols are correctly parsed or stripped before reaching the editorial engine.
Update the editorial_engine.py validation logic to handle mixed-type numeric comparisons (integer vs. percentage string).
Re-run the pipeline after normalizing the source metrics schema to match the expected deck output format.
